text:
anya: heads up — saw a weird reranker drift after onboarding openlm-7b-embedding via HF->Redwood conversion. NDCG down ~0.03 on our dev eval.

miguel: can you paste the tokenizer/config you used? sounds like a CLS/pooling mismatch again.

anya: here's the minimal conversion config we shipped to staging:
```json
{
  "model_max_length": 2048,
  "truncation_side": "right",
  "bos_token": "<s>",
  "eos_token": "</s>",
  "cls_token": null
}
```

samir: if cls_token is null but bos_token exists, HF often expects bos used as sequence start. Our embedding pooler expects an explicit CLS token at index 0. conversion might be inserting a synthetic CLS and shifting offsets.

sophia: quick repro you can run locally:
```py
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
t = Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json')
print(t.encode('Hello world').ids)
```
compare HF ids vs converted tokenizers. We had a case where converted tokenizer returned `[0, 72, 523]` (0 is synthetic CLS) while HF returned `[72, 523]`. That off-by-one means truncation dropped the wrong token when near max length.

miguel: also check truncation_side mismatch. In one model HF used "left" truncation for conversation context; if conversion flips to "right" you'll end up removing the leading context and the pooler picks the wrong position for CLS.

anya: verified locally: original HF tokenizer `encode` -> no CLS added. converted -> inserted  token id 0 at start. when sequence length == model_max_length, our redispatch truncation removed the final real token instead of preserving it.

samir: on top of that, our int8 quantization experiment introduced small embedding-norm shifts. mean cosine(fp16, int8) ~0.997, but tail samples drop to 0.85 which affects rerank ordering. Combined with token offset shifts, it magnified NDCG regression.

anya: quick numbers from the failing eval: fp16 avg NDCG=0.782, int8 collapsed pipeline NDCG=0.749 (drop 0.033). top1 acc drop ~1.7%.

sophia: proposed fixes: 1) conversion should preserve explicit special-token mapping (map bos->cls only if tokenizer semantics indicate it), 2) ensure truncation_side is copied verbatim, 3) add a small calibration pass for embedding quant to keep norm scale.

miguel: I can patch the HF->RW conversion script: if tokenizer.json lacks cls_token but has bos_token, set `cls_token` to bos_token only for `embedding_pool` metadata (don't change model autoreg behavior). Also write `truncation_side` explicitly into converted config and add unit test comparing token ids for ~100 random sentences.

anya: I'll re-run reranker eval after that patch + re-run int8 with Per-Channel KL calibration. If numbers look good we can backport to staging dedicated cluster.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: branch conversion-fix -> staging at 2026-03-21 03:30 UTC.

samir: :thumbsup: also add a CI test that computes cosine similarity distribution (fp16 vs int8) on a small sample and fails if mean < 0.995 or tail 5% < 0.9.

sophia: and please add a short note in eng-ml docs with three gotchas: 1) cls mapping, 2) truncation_side, 3) quantization calibration. Saves future onboarding pain.

miguel: will add doc + unit tests. tagging @anya for repro artifacts.

anya: added a gist with repro artifacts and eval CSV: https://gist.github.com/redwood/abc123 — contains token dumps, config before/after, and eval CSV. I will post results here once CI runs.
